This appeal is filed against the judgment and award dated 10.03.2022 passed in MVC No.169/2020 by the Senior Civil Judge & MACT-XV, Chittapur.

The deceased Beerappa Nippani,
aged about 30 years, was the rider of bike No.KA-32-- EB-4517.
He met with an accident on 24.11.2019 and died.

His wife and children filed claim petition claiming compensation of Ningamma And Ors vs Kapil And Anr on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7610115/

sentences.text: The Tribunal, considering the entire evidence on record, granted compensation of Rs.23,44,100/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of deposit.

4. Aggrieved by the said order, this appeal is filed seeking enhancement of compensation and it is contended that the deceased was earning Rs.25,000/- per month, and loss of consortium was not granted properly, so also the meager amounts were granted for funeral expenses and under other heads, and therefore, requested for enhancement.

5. Heard the arguments of both sides.
6.
The claimants failed to produce any documents to prove the income of the deceased, who met with an accident in NC: 2025:KHC-K:6621 HC-KAR the year 2019.

Therefore, notional income of Rs.13,250/- is to be taken as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, and as the deceased was aged 30 years at the time of accident, the proper multiplier is to be taken is 17.
40% of income is to be added towards future prospects as per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of National Insurance Company Limited Vs. Pranay Sethi1 and one third is to be deducted towards personal expenses as per the guidelines of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sarla Verma Vs. Delhi Transport Corporation2.

In the result, the following order is passed:
(2017) 16 SCC 680 NC: 2025:KHC-K:6621 HC-KAR (i) Appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The appellant-claimants are entitled for the total compensation of Rs.26,96,800/-
with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of realization.

( iii) The respondent-insurance company has already deposited the awarded amount before the Tribunal, and therefore, they are directed to deposit the enhanced amount of Rs.3,52,700/- with interest at 6% per annum within one month from the date of copy of this order.
(v) On such deposit, the 1st petitioner-claimant alone is permitted to withdraw the amount along with aforesaid interest.
